name: Preamble
text: This EMPLOYMENT AGREEMENT (this “Agreement” is dated as of July 9", 2014 by and between Maik Lankau (“Executive”) and Luxoft USA, Inc., a Delaware corporation with its principal business address at 100 Wall Street, Suite 503, New York NY 10005 (the “Corporation”). Certain capitalized terms are defined in Section 8 of this Agreement.

name: Background / Consideration
text: In consideration of Executive’s employment with the Corporation and receipt of compensation paid to Executive by the Corporation, and the Corporation’s agreement to provide Executive with its Confidential Information, the Corporation and Executive agree to the following terms and conditions.

name: 1. Scope and Purpose
text: 1. Scope and Purpose. The Corporation desires to assure itself of Executive's employment, and Executive desires to be employed by the Corporation on the terms and conditions set forth in this Agreement.

name: 2. Start Date (Effective Date)
text: Zs Start Date (“Effective Date”). The start date for of Executive’s employment shall be August 15", 2014.

name: 3. Employment and Duties
text: A Employment and Duties. Subject to the terms and conditions of this Agreement, the Corporation shall employ Executive as the Managing Director — Telecommunications and Embedded Systems or in another management position assigned to Executive by the Corporation’s Board of Directors (the “Board”). In particular, Executive shall be accountable for profitable growth of business relationships with selected clients of the Corporation, he shall serve as line manager for all personnel involved in service delivery. Executive is expected to contribute to expansion of the Corporation’s business in worldwide with a particular focus on North America, being a key member of the regional management team. A more detailed outline of the Executive’s responsibilities is set forth on Exhibit A to this Agreement, which is incorporated in and made part of this Agreement. Executive shall report to Vice President of Technology Services of the Corporation. Executive accepts such employment and agrees to devote his full time and attention to the business and affairs of the Corporation.

name: 4. Compensation and Benefits (introduction)
text: 4. Compensation and Benefits. As consideration for all of Executive’s services to the Corporation, Executive shall receive the following while Executive is employed by the Corporation:

name: Section 4(a) — Base Salary (annual review at Board discretion)
text: (a) Base Salary. The Corporation shall pay Executive a base annual salary of Three Hundred Thousand Dollars ($300,000) (as adjusted from time to time, the “Base Salary”), which shall be payable by the Corporation in regular installments in accordance with the Corporation’s general payroll practices (as in effect from time to time). Executive’s Base Salary for any partial year will be based on the number of days actually elapsed in that year. Executive’s Base Salary shall be subject to annual review for adjustment at the discretion of the Board (any salary so adjusted shall thereafter be the Base Salary for purposes of this Agreement). The next salary adjustment is scheduled for <— April 1, 2015.

name: 4(b) Annual Bonus
text: (b) Annual Bonus. The Executive shall have the right to receive an annual bonus in the amount of $140,000 (“Annual Bonus”), which shall be paid to Executive semiannually, provided that (i) the Executive remains an employee of the Corporation in good standing on the date of payment, and (ii) Executive satisfies the Key Performance Indicators (“KPI”) established by the Corporation in accordance with its standard KPI system for the position held by Executive provided that for the period between the Effective Date and December 31, 2014 the KPI execution shall be set to 100%.

name: 4(c) 401(k) Plan Participation
text: (c) 401(k) Plan Participation. Executive shall be entitled to a matching contribution by the Corporation under its 401(k) Plan (the “Plan”) in an amount commensurate with Executive’s position in accordance with standard policies of the Corporation, commencing at such time when the Company is able to make such matching contribution under the Plan (“Contribution Start Date”). Prior to the Contribution Start Date, Executive shall have the right to receive a bonus in the amount of $18,000 (“Additional Bonus”), which shall be paid to Executive at the end of each fiscal year of the Corporation between the Effective Date and the Contribution Start Date. Additional Bonus shall be prorated for any time period that is less than twelve (12) calendar months.

name: Section 4(d) — Other Benefits (Stock Option Plan eligibility)
text: (d) Other Benefits. In addition to (but without duplication of) the Base Salary and any bonus, while Executive is employed by the Corporation, Executive shall be eligible to participate in the Stock Option Plan (subject to approval by the Board and the Corporation’s policies), and such other pension, life insurance, health insurance, disability insurance and other employee benefits plans, if any, which the Corporation may from time to time make available to its executive employees generally. Executive shall also be entitled to twenty (20) working days of paid vacation per year. Executive shall also be entitled to sick days, vacation days and accrual and carryover of such days and unused vacation days in accordance with the standard policies of the Corporation (as in effect from time to time). Nothing in this Agreement will preclude the Corporation from amending or terminating any of the programs applicable to executive employees so long as such amendments apply to all similarly situated employees.

name: 4(e) Expenses
text: (e) Expenses. Executive shall be reimbursed by the Corporation for all reasonable out-of-pocket business expenses incurred by Executive in the performance of Executive’s duties and responsibilities under this Agreement in accordance with the Corporation’s standard policies regarding expense verification, reporting, documentation and reimbursement practices.

name: Section 5(a) — Termination / at-will and ninety days' notice
text: (a) Executive understands, acknowledges and agrees that Executive is an “atwill” Employee, and that Executive’s employment by the Corporation will terminate (i) automatically and immediately upon Executive's death or Disability, and (ii) may be terminated by the Corporation (through action by the Board) for any reason or no reason, whether with or without Cause, at any time by giving Executive notice of the termination, subject only to the contractual rights upon termination set forth herein; provided that if the Corporation terminates the Executive without Cause, the Executive shall be entitled to ninety (90) days prior notice to be given by the Corporation. The terms of this Agreement, therefore, do not and are not intended to create either an express or implied contract of employment with the Corporation for any particular period of time. Executive may terminate his employment by the Corporation by giving the Corporation written notice of at least ninety (90) days in advance of his termination date; provided that upon receipt of notice of termination from Executive, the Corporation may, in its sole discretion, request that Executive cease employment activities prior to the termination date specified in accordance with this Section 4, and Executive shall comply with such request, it being understood that such request will not change the termination date specified in accordance with this Section 4 or affect the characterization of the termination of Executive’s employment.

name: 5(b) No Other Compensation After Termination
text: (b) Except as otherwise expressly provided in this Agreement, Executive shall not be entitled to any other salary, bonuses. employee benefits or compensation from the Corporation after his termination, and all of Executive’s rights to salary, bonuses, employee benefits and other compensation hereunder which would have accrued or become payable after his termination (other than vested retirement benefits accrued on or prior to the termination or expiration of his employment, accrued insurance benefits or other amounts owing under the Corporation’s standard, Board-approved policies as of the date of such termination or expiration that have not yet been paid) shall cease upon such termination or expiration, other than as expressly required under applicable law (such as COBRA).

name: 5(c) Offset
text: (c) The Corporation may offset any bona fide amounts not in dispute that Executive owes It against any amounts it owes Executive under this Agreement.

name: 6. Restrictive Covenants — Scope and Purpose
text: Scope and Purpose. Executive acknowledges that the Corporation is engaged in the business of providing to its customers, whether directly or through one or more subsidiaries, custom software and/or application development, custom software or application maintenance, offshore software development, software architecture services, software quality assurance, IT strategy consulting and software process consulting (the “Business”). Executive acknowledges and agrees that during the course of his employment with the Corporation, he will have access to valuable and confidential professional and business information of the Corporation, its substantial relationships with prospective and existing service recipients, clients, and customers, trade secrets, and similar information. Executive further acknowledges and agrees that it is essential to the conduct of the Corporation’s business, the sale of its products and the provision of its services and to the protection of its shareholders’ investments that the foregoing information be kept confidential and that its professional and business relationships be protected.

name: 6. Other Restrictions
text: Other Restrictions, Executive represents and warrants to the Corporation that the Executive is not a party to any restrictive covenant limiting his right to perform services for the Corporation in any capacity whatsoever.

name: 6. Conflict of Interest
text: Conflict of Interest. During the Term of this Agreement and for a period of twenty-four (24) months after termination of this Agreement, the Executive hereby agrees, for himself and for any existing or future company affiliated with him, not to, directly or indirectly, in any capacity, either for himself or on behalf of another person, engage in any new transactions, deals or relations of any kind including but not limited to the following: own an interest in, Manage, control, become employed in any position by, enter into a contract, or accept an obligation from, any third party, inconsistent, or incompatible with interests or obligations of the Corporation or any Affiliate thereof (as defined below), represent, participate in or be connected to the management or control of (1) any business which competes with the Business of the Corporation or any of its Affiliates as currently conducted or proposed to be conducted (each of the foregoing, a “Competitive Enterprise”); or attempt to influence the Corporation’s customers to place their business with any other individual or business, and in recognition of the international and national nature of the business of the Corporation, this restriction shall apply throughout the Commonwealth of Independent States (CIS), Europe and the United States (the “Territory”).

name: 6. Non-Solicitation of Clients
text: Non-Solicitation of Clients. During the Term of this Agreement and for a period of twenty-four (24) months after termination of this Agreement, the Executive hereby agrees not to, in any manner, directly or indirectly, for himself and for any existing or future company affiliated with any thereof, (a) Solicit a Client to transact business with a Competitive Enterprise (either for himself or on behalf of another person or entity) or to reduce or refrain from doing any business with the Corporation or any Affiliate thereof or (b) interfere with or damage (or attempt to interfere with or damage) any relationship between the Corporation or any Affiliate thereof, on the one hand, and a Client, on the other hand (capitalized terms used but not defined herein are defined below).

name: 6. Definition of “Solicit”
text: For purposes of this Section, the term “Solicit” means any direct or indirect communication of any kind whatsoever, regardless of by whom initiated, inviting, approaching, canvassing, endeavoring to entice away, advising, encouraging or requesting any person or entity, in any manner, to take or refrain from taking any action.

name: 6. Definition of “Client”
text: For purposes of this Section, the term “Client” means any customer, Client or prospective client of the Corporation or any of its Affiliates to whom the Executive provided services, or for whom the Executive transacted business, or whose identity became known to the Executive in connection with the Executive’s relationship to the Corporation.

name: 6. Definition of “Affiliate”
text: For purposes of this Section, the term “Affiliate” means with respect to the Person in question, any other Person that, directly or indirectly, (i) owns or controls ten percent (10%) or more of the outstanding voting and/or equity securities of such Person, or (ii) controls, is controlled by or is under common control with, the Person in question, and shall include, as 4 . ._ = —__ ee a i _ a =~ Case 1716-cv-08690-RWS- ci applicable, members of the Family of such Person. For the purposes of this definition, the term -control” and its derivations shall mean having the power, directly or indirectly, to direct the management, policies or general conduct of business of the Person in question, whether by the ownership of voting securities, contract or otherwise.

name: 6. Definition of “Person”
text: For purposes of this Section, the term “Person” shall mean any natural person, corporation, general or limited partnership, limited liability company, association, joint venture, trust, estate, governmental authority or other legal entity. in each case whether in its OWN OT a representative capacity.

name: 6. Damages for Breach
text: If the Executive breaches the abovementioned provision, resulting in damages to the Corporation, the Corporation may recover from the Executive any and all damages that may be sustained.

name: 6. Non-Solicitation of Employees
text: Non-Solicitation of Employees. During the Term of this Agreement and for a period of twenty-four (24) months after termination of this Agreement, the Executive hereby agrees for himself and for any existing or future company affiliated with any thereof, not to, directly or indirectly, employ, or Solicit to employ by another company any person who was an employee of the Corporation or its Affiliates at any time during the one year period prior to the date such person becomes employed by the Executive or any existing or future company affiliated with the Executive, unless prior written consent is given by the Executive. If the Executive breaches the abovementioned provision, it shall pay the Corporation the amount of $50,000 for each solicited employee as fixed damages to compensate the Corporation for the damages incurred to by such hiring.

name: 6. Confidentiality and Ownership
text: Confidentiality and Ownership. Executive recognizes and acknowledges that the Corporation possesses certain Confidential Information that constitutes a valuable, special, and unique asset. As used herein, the term “Confidential Information” includes all information and materials belonging to, used by, or in the possession of the Corporation relating to its products, processes, services, technology, inventions, patents. ideas, contracts, financial information, developments, business strategies, pricing, current and prospective customers, marketing plans, and trade secrets of every kind and character, but shall not include (a) information that was already within the public domain at the time the information is acquired by the Executive, or (b) ‘nformation that subsequently becomes public through no act or omission of the Executive. The Executive agrees that all of the Confidential Information is and shall continue to be the exclusive property of the Corporation, whether or not prepared in whole or in part by the Executive and whether or not disclosed to or entrusted to the Executive's custody. Executive agrees that he shall not, at any time following the execution of this Agreement, use Or disclose in any manner any Confidential Information of the Corporation. Executive agrees that upon OF before the termination of his employment with the Corporation, he will return to the Corporation all originals and copies of all records, notes, and other written, printed or other tangible materials in his possession pertaining to the Confidential Information.

name: 6. Assignment of Inventions / Work for Hire
text: To the extent any copyrights, trademarks, ideas, designs, discoveries, inventions, improvements, modifications, developments, processes, algorithms, adjudication methods, works of authorship, documentation, formulas, data, techniques, know-how, trade secrets Or intellectual property or any interest therein, whether or not patentable or capable of copyright or trademark 5 ‘all = _—— —— registration or subject to similar protection (each an “Invention”) or any other inventions, technologies, reports; memoranda, studies, writings, articles, plans, designs, specifications, exhibits, software code, or other materials prepared by the Executive in the performance of services under this Agreement include material subject to copyright protection, such materials have been specially commissioned by the Corporation and they shall be deemed “work for hire” as such term is defined under U.S. copyright law. To the extent any such materials do not qualify as “work for hire” under applicable law, and to the extent they include material subject to copyright, patent, trade secret, or other proprietary rights protection, Executive hereby irrevocably and exclusively assigns to the Corporation, its successors, and assigns, all right, title, and interest in and to all such materials (all of the foregoing Inventions and other materials, made, created, developed, conceived, discovered or reduced to practice by the Executive either alone or with others in his capacity as an employee of the Corporation (collectively, “Assigned Inventions”), except for the materials listed on Exhibit B attached hereto and any other Invention made, created, developed, conceived, discovered or reduced to practice by the Executive either alone or with others outside of his capacity as an employee (collectively, “Retained Inventions”). To the extent any of the Executive's rights in the Assigned Inventions, including without limitation any moral rights, are not subject to assignment hereunder, the Executive hereby irrevocably and unconditionally waives all enforcement of such rights. Executive shall execute and deliver such instruments and take such other actions as may be required to carry out and confirm the assignments contemplated by this paragraph and the remainder of this Agreement. All documents, magnetically or optically encoded media, and other tangible materials created by the Executive as part of his services under this Agreement shall be owned by the Corporation.

name: 6. Maintenance of Records
text: Maintenance of Records. Executive agrees to keep and maintain adequate and current written records of all inventions. The records may be in the form of notes, sketches, drawings, flow charts, electronic data or recordings, laboratory notebooks, and any other format. The records will be available to and, in the case of Assigned Inventions other than Retained Inventions, remain the sole property of the Corporation at all times. Executive agrees not to remove such records from the Corporation’s place of business except as expressly permitted by Corporation policy which may, from time to time, be revised at the sole election of the Corporation for the purpose of furthering the Corporation’s business. Executive agrees to return all records (including any copies thereof) of Assigned Inventions, other than Retained Inventions, to the Corporation at the time of termination of the Executive's employment with the Corporation.

name: 6. Assistance
text: Assistance. Executive agrees to assist the Corporation at the Corporation’s expense, in every way, to create, secure, vest in its name, evidence, enforce and defend the Corporation’s rights, title and interest in and to the Assigned Inventions, other than Retained Inventions, and any copyrights, patents, trademarks, mask work rights, moral rights, or other intellectual property rights relating thereto in the United States and throughout the world, including, without limitation, (i) the disclosure to the Corporation of all pertinent information and data with respect thereto, and (ii) the taking of all actions and the execution of all applications, specifications, oaths, deeds, assignments, recordations, and all other documents and instruments which the Corporation deems necessary or appropriate in order for it to apply for, obtain, maintain and transfer its rights, title and interest in and to such Assigned Inventions, and any copyrights, 6 patents, mask work rights or other intellectual property rights relating thereto. Executive further agrees that it is his obligation to execute or cause to be executed any such document, instrument or papers which shall continue after the termination of this Agreement until the expiration of the last such intellectual property right to expire in any country of the world. If the Corporation is unable because of the Corporation’s mental or physical incapacity or unavailability or for any other reason to secure the Corporation’s signature to apply for or to pursue any application for any United States or foreign patents, copyright, mask works or other registrations or to secure similar protection with respect to the Assigned Inventions, other than the Retained Inventions, and any copyrights, patents, trademarks, mask work rights, moral rights, or other intellectual property rights relating thereto, then the Executive hereby irrevocably designates and appoints the Corporation and its duly authorized officers and agents as the Executive's agent and attorney in fact, to act for and in the Executive’s behalf and stead to execute and file any such applications, sign such other documents and do such other lawfully permitted acts as the Corporation deems necessary or appropriate to further the application for, prosecution, issuance, maintenance or transfer of letters patent, copyright or other registrations or protections thereon with the same legal force and effect as if originally executed by the Executive. Executive hereby waives and irrevocably quitclaims to the Corporation any and all claims, of any nature whatsoever, which the Executive now has or hereafter may have for infringement of any Assigned Invention, other than the Retained Inventions, and any copyrights, patents, trademarks, mask work rights, moral rights, or other intellectual property rights relating thereto.

name: 6. Non-Disclosure Agreement
text: Non-Disclosure Agreement. Simultaneously herewith, the Executive has executed and delivered the Corporation’s standard Non-Disclosure Agreement (the “NDA”).

name: 6. Executive’s Acknowledgments
text: Executive’s Acknowledgments. Executive acknowledges, stipulates, and agrees that the preceding restrictions are reasonably necessary to protect legitimate business interests of the Corporation, including trade secrets and professional information, other valuable confidential or business information, substantial relationships with existing or prospective customers, and customer goodwill associated with the Corporation’s trade name, ongoing business, and the geographical area in which the Corporation conducts its business. The duration of every restriction set forth in this section will be extended by any period during which the Executive ts in breach of his obligations, Executive acknowledges that it makes the preceding covenants as consideration to protect and preserve valuable confidential business and professional information of the Corporation, its substantial business relationships with specific prospective and existing clients and customers, and trade or professional practice secrets associated with its operations, Executive's obligations to the Corporation under the preceding covenants are independent of any other obligation between the Corporation and the Executive, including any promise or agreement contained in this Agreement or any other agreement between the Parties.

name: 6. Non-Disparagement
text: Non-Disparagement. Executive shall not intentionally disparage the Corporation or its subsidiaries and affiliates orally or in writing or make any public statement reflecting negatively on the Corporation or its subsidiaries and affiliates to third parties, irrespective of the truthfulness or falsity of such statement, except as may otherwise be required by applicable law or compelled by process of law.

name: 6. Judicial Modification
text: Judicial Modification. Executive agrees that the provisions of this Agreement are severable and that it is the Executive’s and the Corporation’s intent that the restrictions contained 7 in this Agreement be enforced to the fullest extent permissible under the laws of each jurisdiction in which enforcement is sought. If any of the restrictions contained in this Agreement are for any reason held by a court to be excessively broad as to duration, activity, geographical scope, or subject, then such restrictions will be construed, judicially modified, or “blue penciled” in such jurisdiction so as to thereafter be limited or reduced to the extent required to be enforceable in such jurisdiction in accordance with applicable law. If any of the restrictions contained in this Agreement are held to be invalid, illegal, or unenforceable in any respect under any applicable law in any jurisdiction, then such invalidity, illegality, or unenforceability will not affect any other provision of this letter or any other jurisdiction, but such restrictions will be reformed, construed, and enforced in such jurisdiction as if such invalid, illegal, or unenforceable restrictions had never been contained in this Agreement. Executive hereby acknowledges and agrees that, due to (a) the nature of the restrictions contained in this Agreement, (b) the global nature of the Corporation’s business and the Executive’s position within the Corporation, and (c) the technological advancements in electronic communications around the world, any further geographic restriction within the Territory of the Executive’s obligations under the restrictive covenants above would be inappropriate and counter to the protections sought by the Corporation thereunder.

name: 6. Remedies
text: Remedies. Executive stipulates that a breach by him of any of the foregoing covenants in this Agreement will diminish the value of the Corporation and will cause imreparable and continuing injury to the Corporation and any third party beneficiary pursuant to below Section entitled “Third Party Enforcement; Assignment; Successors” (a “Third Party Beneficiary”) for which an adequate legal remedy will not exist. Accordingly, the Executive stipulates that, if it breaches any of the covenants of this Agreement, the Corporation will be excused from paying or performing any liability or obligation owed to the Executive (including compensation) under this Agreement and, without limiting or excluding any other available remedy, the Corporation and any Third Party Beneficiary each will be entitled to the following remedies: (a) entry by a court having jurisdiction of an order granting specific performance or injunctive relief; without requirement of a bond or proof of monetary damage or an inadequate remedy at law: (b) the recovery from the Executive of all profit, remuneration, or other consideration that the Executive gains from breaching the covenant and any damages suffered by the Corporation, to the extent ascertainable; and (c) reimbursement from the Executive of all costs incurred by the Corporation in enforcing the covenant or otherwise defending or prosecuting any mediation, arbitration, or litigation arising out of the covenant. The Corporation and any Third Party Beneficiary may exercise any of the foregoing remedies concurrently, independently, or successively.

name: 7. Representations of the Executive
text: 7. Representations of the Executive. Executive hereby represents and warrants to the Corporation that (i) the execution, delivery and performance of this Agreement by Executive do not and shall not conflict with, breach, violate or cause a default under any contract, agreement, instrument, order, judgment or decree to which Executive is a party or by which Executive is bound, (ii) Executive is not a party to or bound by any employment agreement, non-compete agreement or confidentiality agreement with any other person or entity, and (iii) upon the execution and delivery of this Agreement by the Corporation, this Agreement shall be the valid and binding obligation of Executive, enforceable in accordance with its terms. Executive hereby acknowledges and represents that Executive has consulted with independent legal counsel regarding Executive’s rights and obligations under this Agreement and that Executive fully understands the terms and conditions contained herein.

name: 8(a) Jurisdiction and Venue
text: (a) Jurisdiction and Venue. The laws of the State of New York and the federal laws of the United States of America, excluding the laws of those jurisdictions pertaining to resolution of conflicts with laws of other jurisdictions, govern the validity, enforcement, construction, and interpretation of this Agreement. Executive and the Corporation (1) consent to the personal jurisdiction of the state and federal courts having jurisdiction in New York, New York, (ii) stipulate that a proper and convenient venue for any legal proceeding arising out of this Agreement is New York, New York, for a state court proceeding, or the federal court having jurisdiction in New York, New York, for a federal court proceeding, and (ili) waive any defense, whether asserted by motion or pleading, that New York, New York, or the federal court having jurisdiction in New York, New York is an improper or inconvenient venue.

name: 8(b) Waiver of Trial By Jury
text: (b) Waiver of Trial By Jury. EXECUTIVE AND THE CORPORATION KNOWINGLY, VOLUNTARILY, AND INTENTIONALLY WAIVE THE RIGHT TO A JURY TRIAL IN ANY LAWSUIT BETWEEN THEM THAT ARISES AT ANY TIME OUT OF THIS AGREEMENT OR EXECUTIVE’S EMPLOYMENT WITH THE CORPORATION, WHETHER AT LAW OR IN EQUITY, WHETHER BASED ON A CLAIM OR COUNTERCLAIM ARISING BEFORE OR AFTER THE EFFECTIVE DATE OF THIS AGREEMENT, REGARDLESS OF THE NATURE OF THE CLAIM OR COUNTERCLAIM, AND INCLUDING CLAIMS UNDER TORT, CONTRACT, CORPORATE, AND EMPLOYMENT LAWS.

name: 8(c) Costs
text: (c) Costs. In any mediation, arbitration, or legal proceeding between Executive and the Corporation arising out of this Agreement, the losing party shall reimburse the prevailing party, on demand, for all costs incurred by the prevailing party in enforcing, defending, or prosecuting this Agreement.

name: 9(a) Definition of “Affiliate”
text: (a) “Affiliate” shall mean any entity that, directly or indirectly, is controlled by, controls, or is under common control with, the Corporation.

name: 9(b) Definition of “Cause”
text: (b) “Cause” means if the Executive has: (i) engaged in deliberate acts of unlawful behavior, dishonesty, theft, embezzlement or fraud against or at the expense of the Corporation or any of its Clients, customers, suppliers or business relations; (ii) been indicted, convicted of, or pleased nolo contendere, to any felony; (iii) engaged in misconduct in the performance of Executive's duties as an employee of the Corporation and such misconduct has a substantial adverse affect on the Corporation, including without limitation, persistent negative feedback from Clients regarding Executive's performance or request by any Client to remove Executive from its account; (iv) used illegal substances in the workplace or habitual substance abuse: or (v) breached the Restrictive Covenants set forth in Section 5 of this Agreement, or breached this Agreement, or the NDA, or any material Corporation policy or other agreement between Corporation and Executive.

name: 9(c) Definition of “Disability”
text: (c) “Disability” means that, as a result of his incapacity due to physical or mental illness, Executive is considered disabled under the Corporation’s long-term disability insurance plans or, in the absence of such plans, Executive is unable to perform the essential duties, responsibilities and functions of his position with the Corporation as a result of any mental or physical disability or incapacity even with reasonable accommodations of such disability or incapacity provided by the Corporation or if providing such accommodations would be unreasonable, all as determined by the Board in its good faith judgment. Executive shall cooperate in all respects with the Corporation if a question arises as to whether he has a Disability (including, without limitation, submitting to an examination by a medical doctor or other health care specialists selected by the Corporation and authorizing such medical doctor or such other health care specialist to discuss Executive’s condition with the Corporation).

name: 9(d) Definition of “Good Reason”
text: (d) “Good Reason” shall mean if Executive determines in good faith that: (1) the Corporation has breached any material term(s) or material condition(s) of this Agreement, which breach was not caused or consented to by Executive and has not been cured by the Corporation, or the Corporation is not otherwise diligently pursuing a remedy, within twenty-one (21) business days after receiving written notice from Executive delineating the claimed breach and setting forth his intention to terminate his employment if such breach is not duly remedied. or the Corporation is not otherwise diligently pursuing a remedy, within twenty-one (21) business days; (ii) the Corporation has. without Executive’s consent, materially reduced Executive’s overall level of duties and responsibilities or title, which reduction has not been cured by the Corporation, or the Corporation is not otherwise diligently pursuing a remedy, within twenty-one (21) business days after receiving written notice from Executive delineating the claimed reduction and setting forth his intention to terminate his employment if such breach is not duly remedied, or the Corporation is not otherwise diligently pursuing a remedy, within twenty-one (21) business days; or (iii) the Corporation has, without Executive's consent, significantly reduced Executive's Base Salary.

name: 10. Third Party Enforcement; Assignment; Successors
text: 10. Third Party Enforcement; Assignment; Successors. Executive shall not assign his rights or delegate any of his obligations under this Agreement, and any attempted assignment or delegation by Executive will be invalid and ineffective against the Corporation. The Corporation may assign its rights under this Agreement (including the restrictive covenants set forth above, which shall be enforceable by the assignee) without Executive’s consent to any assignee or successor in interest of its business, whether pursuant to a sale, merger, contribution of its assets and liabilities, or sale or exchange of all or substantially all the assets or outstanding capital stock or other equity interests of the Corporation. This Agreement is binding on, and ‘nures to the benefit of, the Corporation’s authorized assignees and successors. Upon assignment of the Corporation’s rights under this Agreement, (a) every reference in this Agreement to the “Corporation” will include the assignee, and (b) if the assignee expressly assumes in writing or by operation of law all the liabilities of the assignor generally or under this Agreement specifically, the assignor will be released from all its obligations to Executive under this 10 Agreement.

name: 11. Waiver; Modification; Severability
text: ll. Waiver; Modification; Severability. A waiver, discharge, amendment, or modification of this Agreement will be valid and effective only if evidenced by a writing that is signed by or on behalf of the party against whom the waiver, discharge, amendment, or modification is sought to be enforced. No delay or course of dealing by a party to this Agreement in exercising any right, power, or remedy under this Agreement will operate as a waiver of any right, power, or remedy of that party, except to the extent expressly manifested in writing by that party. The failure at any time of either party to require performance by the other party of any provision of this Agreement will in no way affect the party’s right thereafter to enforce the provision or this Agreement, In addition, the waiver by a party of a breach of any provision of this Agreement will not constitute a waiver of any succeeding breach of the provision or a waiver of the provision itself. Whenever possible, each provision of this Agreement should be construed and interpreted so that it is valid and enforceable under applicable law. If a court determines that a covenant or agreement in this Agreement is unenforceable, that covenant or agreement will be deemed separable from the remaining covenants and agreements in this Agreement and will not affect the validity, interpretation, or effect of the other provisions of this Agreement or the application of that covenant or agreement to other circumstances to which it is enforceable,

name: 12. Recurring Words
text: 12, Recurring Words. As used in this Agreement, (a) the word “including” is always without limitation, (b) the word “days” refers to calendar days, including Saturdays, Sundays, and holidays, (c) words in the singular number include words in the plural number and vice versa, (d) the word “law” includes a code, rule, statute, ordinance, or regulation and the common law arising from final, non-appealable decisions of state and federal courts in the United States, (e) the word “person” includes, in addition to a natural person, a trust, eroup, syndicate, corporation, cooperative, association, partnership, business trust, joint venture, limited liability company, unincorporated organization, and a government, a public body or authority, and any governmental body, agency, authority, department, or subdivision, whether domestic or foreign or local, state, regional, or national, and (f) the word “costs” includes all fees, costs, and expenses of experts, attorneys, paralegals, mediators, arbitrators, witnesses, and supersedeas bonds, whether incurred before or after demand or commencement of legal proceedings, and whether incurred pursuant to trial, appellate, mediation, arbitration, bankruptcy, administrative, or judgment-execution proceedings.

name: 13. Notices
text: 13. Notices. Every notice, demand, consent, or other communication required or permitted under this Agreement will be valid only if it is in writing (whether or not this Agreement expressly states that it must be in writing) and delivered personally or by commercial overnight courier, or first-class, postage-prepaid, United States mail (whether or not certified or registered, and regardless of whether a return receipt is requested or received by the sender), and addressed to the addresses for the parties listed below. A validly given notice, demand, consent, or other communication will be effective on the earlier of its receipt, if delivered personally or commercial courier, or the third day after it is postmarked by the United States Postal Service, if delivered by first-class, postage-prepaid, United States mail.

name: Section 14 — Execution; Complete Agreement (merger clause)
text: i4. Execution; Complete Agreement. The titles and headings preceding the text of li the sections of this Agreement are inserted solely for convenient reference and neither constitutes a part of this Agreement nor affects its meaning, interpretation, or effect. The parties may execute this Agreement in counterparts (including by means of facsimile and electronic transmission in portable document format (PDF)). Each executed counterpart of this Agreement will constitute an original document, and all of them, together, will constitute the same agreement. This Agreement will become effective, as of its stated date of execution, when each party has signed and delivered a counterpart of it to the other party. This Agreement records the final, complete, and exclusive understanding of the parties with respect to the matters addressed herein and supersede any prior or contemporaneous agreement, representation, or understanding. oral or written, by either of them.

name: 15. Insurance
text: 15. Insurance, The Corporation may, at its discretion, apply for and procure in its own name and for its own benefit life and/or disability insurance on Executive in any amount or amounts considered advisable. Executive agrees to cooperate in any medical or other examination, supply any information and execute and deliver any applications or other instruments in writing as may be reasonably necessary to obtain and constitute such insurance.

name: 16. No Strict Construction
text: 16. No Strict Construction. The language used in this Agreement shall be deemed to be the language chosen by the parties to express their mutual intent, and no tule of strict construction shall be applied against any party.

name: 17. Effectiveness of Agreement
text: 17. Effectiveness of Agreement. Executive’s employment under this Agreement shall become effective on the Effective Date.

name: 18. Survival
text: 18. Survival. Sections 4 through 18, inclusive, shall survive and continue in full force and effect in accordance with their terms notwithstanding the termination of the Executive.

name: 19(a) Section 409A Compliance
text: (a) This Agreement is intended to comply with Section 409A of the Internal Revenue Code of 1986, as amended (“Section 409A”) and shall, to the extent practicable, be construed in accordance therewith. Accordingly, notwithstanding anything in this Agreement to the contrary, if the Corporation determines that the Executive is a “specified employee” (as defined in Code Section 409A(a)(2)(B)(i)) at the time of his Separation from Service (as defined under Section 409A) and any amount payable to the Executive under this Agreement is a deferral of compensation subject to the additional tax described in Code Section 409A(a)(1)(B) and would be considered a payment upon the Executive's Separation from Service, then notwithstanding anything in this Agreement to the contrary, such amount shall not be paid before the date that is the earlier of (i) six (6) months and one (1) day after the Executive's Separation from Service or (ii) Executive’s death (the “Delay Period”). Upon the expiration of the Delay Period, the initial payment following the Delay Period shall include a lump sum payment equal to those payments that otherwise would have been paid if the delay had not applied, and any remaining payments due shall be payable in accordance with their original payment schedule.

name: 19(b) Section 409A Amendment
text: (b) If either party to this Agreement reasonably determines that any amount payable pursuant to this Agreement would result in adverse tax consequences under Section 12 409A (including, but not limited to, the additional tax described in Code Section 409A(a)(1)(B)), then such party shall deliver written notice of such determination to the other party, and the parties hereby agree to work in good faith to amend this Agreement so it (i) is exempt from, or compliant with, the requirements of Section 409A and (ii) preserves as nearly as possible the original intent and economic effect of the affected provisions.
